chapter.heading: A song. A psalm of the descendants of Korah.
chapter.v:
The Lord
founded the city on his holy mountain.

Jerusalem is
the city that the Lord loves more than any other city in Israel.

Many wonderful
things are said of you, city of God! Selah.

I mention
Egypt and Babylon as those who know me, and in addition Philistia, Tyre, and Ethiopia—“this man was born there.”

It will
be said concerning Jerusalem, “Everyone was born there,” and the Most High will make it secure.

When the
Lord registers the nations, he will write, “They were born there.” Selah.

Singers and
dancers alike say, “Living here I am at home.”
